Title: Object Matching
Description: Visual matching of animals and everyday objects to build vocabulary.

Title: Functional Use of Objects
Description: Match everyday objects to their correct use to support functional language.

Title: Emotional Recognition
Description: Identify facial emotions to build empathy and emotional awareness.

Title: Color Discrimination
